item.title: Retake 1.0.23
item.description: • Pin or hide the inspector. A pin at the top of the inspector keeps it beside the editor. Unpin it and it slides away so the editor uses the whole window; click the strip on the window's right edge to slide it in, and click outside it to put it away.

item.title: Retake 1.0.22
item.description:
• Smooth playback while editing. Changing a speed change (or anything else that rebuilds the video) while playing no longer makes the playhead jump to the start or pause; playback carries straight on. The playhead also no longer steps back when you press play.
  • Markers stay on their frame. A marker marks a frame of the recording: adding, changing or deleting a speed change, or trimming, moving or deleting clips, moves it with that frame. A marker in a freeze frame keeps its place in the freeze.
  • The view is saved with the project. Where the timeline is scrolled to, how far it is zoomed, and the playhead are saved and restored when you open the project again.

item.title: Retake 1.0.21
item.description:
• Crossfades. Audio items that run into each other on the same lane now crossfade across the overlap instead of cutting over. The overlap is drawn with the two fade curves crossing.
  • Hear a trim. While dragging the edge of a voiceover, camera take or music item, press Space to hear the second of audio at the new edge; a small playhead follows it.
  • Freeze frames start and stop at once, with no easing. Other speed changes keep their easing.
  • Timeline locked while narrating. While a voiceover records, the timeline is dimmed and can't be edited, so nothing moves under the narration.

item.title: Retake 1.0.20
item.description:
• Hold the picture while you talk. While recording a voiceover, press ⇧Space (or click Hold Picture) to stop the video while your voice and camera keep recording, so you can finish a sentence. The preview shows PAUSED; Space or ⇧Space carries on. When the voiceover stops, each hold becomes a freeze frame on the Speed lane, so the narration stays in step with the picture.
  • Markers while narrating. Press M during a voiceover to add a marker at the playhead.

item.title: Retake 1.0.19
item.description: • Automatic updates. Retake now checks for new versions once a day and offers to install them; Retake › Check for Updates… checks straight away, and Check for Updates Automatically turns the daily check off. Updates are signed and verified before they are installed. Earlier versions don't check, so this version is installed by hand once; later versions are offered automatically.
